feeds.title: Melbourne Food & Wine Festival
feeds.description: Melbourne Food & Wine Festival is a statewide celebration of Victoria's food and wine industry that attracts more than 150,000 attendees to a diverse program of hundreds of events.

feeds.title: A Baking Journey
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Sylvie, a Belgian Expat living in Melbourne, Australia. I am a passionate Baker who loves to share her favorite recipes and baking tips. Bake your way through life with inspired Recipes for all home bakers. Find your next favorite cakes, desserts, and baked goods here.

feeds.title: BLK's Food Blog
feeds.description: I have been heavily into food and wine for more than two decades. I am not overly fussy and focus on the positives. I move around, going to new restaurants very regularly, and only going back to a handful that I don't consider convenient. I give you 100% independent views of restaurants in Melbourne and beyond.

feeds.title: Consider The Sauce
feeds.description: Consider the sauce is a Melbourne's food blog which provides information about the marvellous food and cultures of Melbourne's western suburbs.

feeds.title: The Spice Adventuress
feeds.description: Hi, I am Dhanya. The Spice Adventuress is my alter ego. Through her, I fulfill my desire to put my thoughts into words, explore my restless creative soul and express it through food and photography. Discover the world of spices through hundreds of recipes from around the globe and may it inspire you to get into the kitchen and cook something delicious.

feeds.title: Howie's Melbourne Food Blog
feeds.description: I am an independent blogger based in the Western Suburbs of Melbourne. My real interest is in photography so my blogs/reviews let me enjoy my photography hobby while sharing with you any great and not so great cafes and restaurants I come across in my daily life.

feeds.title: Olive Sundays Blog
feeds.description: Olive Sundays is a Melbourne food blog where you can search for great places to eat in Melbourne, learn how to make utterly delicious meals, be inspired by food bits, and get the chance to win some mouth-watering prizes. Whether you're new to Melbourne, traveling to Melbourne, have lived in Melbourne your whole life, or just have a general love for food, we have something here for you.

feeds.title: Lisa Eats World
feeds.description: Welcome to Lisa Eats World, a blog that shares two of my biggest passions in life - food and travel. My aim is to 'eat the world' one inch at a time and explore as many different cuisines and cultures as possible.

feeds.title: 1001 Dinners 1001 Nights
feeds.description: Originally a culinary journey through the best (and sometimes not the best) eateries in Melbourne interstate and international. This site is a free guide. Your comments are very welcome and any contributions will be added to the site. Feel free to email us reviews, anytime and anywhere.

feeds.title: Suzie Scribbles
feeds.description: At Suzie Scribbles we bring you everything there is to know about Melbourne Food and Drink. You can check out our food and drink guide - organized by area or suburb to find great places to eat and drink near you or our handy 'best of's' help you find your perfect dish, cafe, or restaurant.

feeds.title: Food Voyageur
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Rachi. My cooking blog focuses on recipes that you can count on and everyday low-budget meals. So what you will find in my blog is simple, flavorful everyday meals that are so simple to recreate, because I will teach you simple tricks to elevate your everyday cooking or how to get maximum flavor with limited ingredients.
